fact: Madagascar has adopted implementing decree 2023-1541 for the data-protection law and ratified the Malabo Convention in 2024, and AFAPDP experts worked 10-21 February 2025 to operationalise the CMIL, the authority overseeing personal-data processing under law 2014-038.
title: Renforcement de la gouvernance numérique à Madagascar : vers une protection efficace des données
